assertions.description: RTCPeerConnection.prototype has no createDTMFSender member (WPT webrtc/historical.html?interop-2026).
typeof RTCPeerConnection.prototype.createDTMFSender is "undefined" — the legacy method is gone, not merely stubbed.
Calling pc.createDTMFSender(track) with an audio track that IS attached to the connection throws (TypeError: not a function), instead of returning an RTCDTMFSender.
The replacement exists: RTCRtpSender.prototype exposes the dtmf attribute.
An audio RTCRtpSender's dtmf returns an RTCDTMFSender whose canInsertDTMF is false before negotiation.
assertions.test: (()=>{const ac=new AudioContext();const d=ac.createMediaStreamDestination();const t=d.stream.getAudioTracks()[0];const pc=new RTCPeerConnection();const s=pc.addTrack(t,d.stream);const ok=s.dtmf instanceof RTCDTMFSender&&s.dtmf.canInsertDTMF===false;pc.close();t.stop();ac.close();return ok;})()

assertions.description: A video RTCRtpSender's dtmf is null (DTMF is audio-only).
RTCDTMFSender exposes insertDTMF(), toneBuffer, canInsertDTMF and ontonechange.
assertions.test: typeof RTCDTMFSender === 'function' && typeof RTCDTMFSender.prototype.insertDTMF === 'function' && ['toneBuffer','canInsertDTMF','ontonechange'].every(k => k in RTCDTMFSender.prototype)

assertions.description: insertDTMF() on a sender that is not yet sending throws InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (()=>{const ac=new AudioContext();const d=ac.createMediaStreamDestination();const t=d.stream.getAudioTracks()[0];const pc=new RTCPeerConnection();const s=pc.addTrack(t,d.stream);let n='none';try{s.dtmf.insertDTMF('1');}catch(e){n=e.name;}pc.close();t.stop();ac.close();return n==='InvalidStateError';})()

assertions.description: RTCDTMFToneChangeEvent can be constructed and carries the tone.
